summary: Iteration 3 covers the new UNLOCKED create-flow, script/config editors, API-keys vault, mode-routing and 8 video-type registry. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass in 4.04s across TestVideoTypes (8-registry integrity + required fields), TestCreateStory (tech+clip+45s→vt-tech channel+job enqueued, 400 empty, 400 unknown type, 9999→clamp 240), TestPatchScript (chunk0 edit persists + audio cache /app/backend/media/audio/{id}/00.mp3 unlinked, 404 unknown story), TestStoryConfig (mode slide↔clip wipes clips dir, target 9999→240 & 5→30 clamp), TestApiKeysVault (11 keys with set/hint only + no raw leak, HF_TOKEN PUT saved & masked & DELETE clears, unknown key rejected quietly on PUT & 400 on DELETE), TestRouterStatus (gemini_veo/hf_flux/kokoro/kenburns present), TestAdminGating (401 anon / 403 non-admin / 200 admin), TestOpenEndpoints (stories/dashboard/channels(≥8)/media-health all 200 no auth). Direct python services.router.tts('नमस्ते…','kokoro:hm_omega','hi',Path) → provider='kokoro' dur=2.83s (voice-spec parser works). Frontend: / opens dashboard WITHOUT login wall; signin-chip visible in header. /create shows all 8 video-type cards (video-type-{key}), mode-slide-radio, mode-clip-radio, length-slider, create-video-button, and click selection works (farming card + clip + 60s). /settings renders api-keys-card with exactly 11 api-key rows + save-api-keys-button. /stories/6aa57c1eaad23f394fffaa41 renders pipeline-tracker with 7 steps ending 'Uploaded' (Script→Voices→Media→Compiled→QA→Review→Uploaded), improvement-coach-card present, edit-script-button toggles inline editor exposing voiceover-edit-0/visual-edit-0/video-prompt-edit-0 textareas + save-script-edits-button + cancel-script-edits-button; render-config-card correctly ABSENT (hasVideo=true).

critical_code_review_comments: Vault GET response never leaks raw values — verified fake HF_TOKEN 'hf_fake_TESTABCDEF123456' does NOT appear in GET body (only 6-char hint + '…'). Good masking discipline.
PATCH /stories/{id}/script correctly invalidates audio+frame+clip caches for edited indexes (confirmed 00.mp3 absent after edit).
PUT /stories/{id}/config wipes clips dir on mode switch and clamps target_seconds to [30,240] as spec'd.

Auth is now truly optional on /api/stories, /api/dashboard, /api/channels, /api/settings/api-keys, /api/video-types, /api/router-status while /api/admin/* still returns 401 anon and 403 non-admin — segregation is clean.
TestPatchScript fixture snapshotted chunk 0 BEFORE tests to enable restore, but the snapshot itself already contained a stale value from a prior session — main agent should baseline the demo story.
